# Live Score

> Football match notifications and live scores in Telegram via LiveScoreAppBot — personal DMs, groups, channels, and a Mini App. Canonical marketing host: https://football-live-bot.online

Static claim-safe summary for LLM agents. Stick to shipped product facts from the capabilities catalog; do not invent unshipped surfaces.

## English marketing pages

- [Home](https://football-live-bot.online/en): Product overview and bot entry
- [Groups guide](https://football-live-bot.online/en/guide/groups): Register groups for match notifications
- [Channels guide](https://football-live-bot.online/en/guide/channels): Register channels for match notifications
- [Official channels](https://football-live-bot.online/en/official-channels): Marketing page for app-owner league channels (static until live list wiring)
- [Pricing](https://football-live-bot.online/en/pricing): Chat Premium for groups and channels (49 Stars / 30 days)
- [FAQ](https://football-live-bot.online/en/faq): Common product questions
- [Privacy](https://football-live-bot.online/en/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://football-live-bot.online/en/terms): Terms of use
